event.name: SC_BOARDER_MARINE
event.text: Enemy assault team approaching!

event.name: SC_BOARDER_FIRE
event.text: Need a light?

event.name: SC_BOARDER_GHOST
event.text: A team of specialists has been sent to collect the bounty on your head.

event.name: SC_TEST
event.text: Oh no enemies!

event.name: SC_TEST2
event.text: Oh no enemies!

choice.text: Send in a specialist to handle it.

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN
event.text: "Stand down. We can transfer supplies if you let us limp out of here."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN_SCOUT
event.text: "You recieve a jumbled message from the heavily damaged ship. The remaining crew has surrendered and is requesting immediate aid."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN_TRANSPORT
event.text: "Fine, fine. Take the cargo. Just do not vent us into space."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss commander transmits a terse offer of withdrawal. Their vessel remains dangerous, but they seem willing to leave.

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: "You have made your point. We are authorized to offer battlefield salvage for safe passage."

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran patrol ship breaks apart. You salvage what remains.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_TERRAN
event.text: With the crew neutralized, you search the Terran vessel and secure its supplies.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_RAIDER
event.text: The raider ship is destroyed. Whatever cargo survived is now yours.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_RAIDER
event.text: The raiders are gone. Their hold is easy to search now.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_ZERG
event.text: The swarm vessel ruptures, leaving behind only scorched biological residue and a few salvageable fragments.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_ZERG
event.text: The infestation is quiet. Your crew carefully collects what can be salvaged.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_INFESTED
event.text: The infested ship collapses in a cloud of spores. You keep your distance and recover whatever drifts clear.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_INFESTED
event.text: The last infested life-sign fades. The ship is dangerous to board, but some supplies are intact.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss ship fractures under your fire. Its strange components are difficult to repurpose, but valuable.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss vessel falls silent. You recover advanced components from the ship.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: The Dominion elite ship is destroyed. Its reinforced hull leaves useful salvage behind.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: With the Dominion crew defeated, you seize their equipment and encrypted supply manifest.
